# a x + y of one limb, y stored

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/reference.py from gen/claims.json, gen/kernels/, include/kairn/gen/, proofs/gen/, proofs/audit/, results/*/brute/, results/brute-code.json and docs/tools/reference_operations.py. Do not edit: run python3 docs/tools/reference.py. -->

Kernel `axpy_step_1` · proved · [all operations](index.md) · [how to read this page](reading.md)

## What it computes

An approximation $z$ of $a x + y$:

$$z \approx a x + y.$$

## C++

**Not yet called by the public headers.** No public operation computes this kernel yet. The operations of the public headers call its core, [`mul_1_1`](mul_1_1.md) and [`add_1_1`](add_1_1.md), instead.

## Requires

- Every limb of every operand is a finite number of `T`.

## Guarantees

When the requirements hold and no operation of the kernel overflows:

- $\lvert z - (a x + y)\rvert \le \left(\frac{2 + 3u}{(1 + u) (1 + u)}\right) u\,(\lvert a x\rvert + \lvert y\rvert) + \tfrac{2}{3}\,\eta$.

The constants of the bound, for each limb type, from `gen/claims.json`:

| | `double` | `float` |
|---|---|---|
| unit roundoff $u$ | $2^{-53}$ | $2^{-24}$ |
| relative term $c\,u$ | $\approx 2.2204 \times 10^{-16}$ | $\approx 1.1921 \times 10^{-7}$ |
| absolute term $t\,\eta$ | $\frac{1}{2^{1074} + 2^{1073}} \approx 3.2938 \times 10^{-324}$ | $\frac{1}{2^{149} + 2^{148}} \approx 9.342 \times 10^{-46}$ |
| `unit`, `tiny`, as compiled | `0x1p-52`, `0x1p-1074` | `0x1p-23f`, `0x1p-149f` |

Proved for every binary format with a precision of at least 1 bit, rounding to nearest with ties to even and with gradual underflow, in the model where no operation overflows. Both limb types qualify: `double` has 53 bits, `float` has 24 bits.

## Status

**Proved.** Rocq checks the theorem `axpy_step_1_correct`, in [`proofs/theories/MapSteps.v`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/proofs/theories/MapSteps.v), against `axpy_step_1_spec`, the statement the generator prints from these claims into [`proofs/gen/Statements.v`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/proofs/gen/Statements.v); the audit of `make -C proofs` prints the axioms its proof depends on (`Print Assumptions axpy_step_1_correct`, in [`proofs/gen/Audit.v`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/proofs/gen/Audit.v)) and finds none beyond the four allowed ([Axioms](#axioms)).

The statement, as Rocq reads it (the vocabulary, `fmt`, `RN`, `u`, `eta` and `normalized_2`, is defined at the top of the same file; `emin` is the exponent of $\eta$ and `prec` the precision):

```coq
Definition axpy_step_1_spec : Prop :=
  forall emin prec : Z, (1 <= prec)%Z ->
  forall a x y : R,
  fmt emin prec a ->
  fmt emin prec x ->
  fmt emin prec y ->
  let z := axpy_step_1 emin prec tie_even a x y in
  fmt emin prec z /\
  Rabs (z - ((a * x) + y)) <= ((2 + (3 * u prec)) / ((1 + u prec) * (1 + u prec))) * u prec ^ 1 * (Rabs (a * x) + Rabs y) + (2 / 3) * eta emin.
```

## Axioms

The audit accepts a proof only if every axiom it depends on is one of the four listed in [`proofs/audit/allowed_axioms.txt`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/proofs/audit/allowed_axioms.txt) ([Proofs](../proofs/index.md#the-four-axioms) says what each states):

- `ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec`
- `ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_not_dec`
- `FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep`
- `Classical_Prop.classic`

Which of them the proof of `axpy_step_1_correct` depends on is not copied here: only a run of Rocq computes it. The CI prints it for every push to `main` and every pull request, and keeps what the audit printed as the artifact `proof-audit` of each run of the [Proofs workflow](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/actions/workflows/proofs.yml).

## Source

**Algorithm:** the step of axpy (milestone2.md, "sum, dot, axpy, convolution"): the product, then the sum, mul_1_1 then add_1_1, each one rounding to nearest, the bound u/(1+u) of [JR18](../developer/design/phase0/references.md#jr18). **License:** algorithm: published; proof: MIT.

## Listing

From [`gen/kernels/axpy_step_1.kernel`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/gen/kernels/axpy_step_1.kernel), the description the C++ and the formal models (`proofs/gen/Model.v`, `proofs/gen/IeeeModel.v`) are generated from. Each line is one operation of `T`; one that rounds rounds to nearest, and `prod(a, b)` is $\mathrm{RN}(ab)$, written as a fused multiply-add with a zero addend ([the kernel IR](../developer/architecture.md#the-kernel-ir)).
It calls [`mul_1_1`](mul_1_1.md), [`add_1_1`](add_1_1.md).

```
# The step of axpy_1 (milestone2.md, "sum, dot, axpy, convolution"): z = (a x) + y, the operations
# of T, each rounded to nearest. The program supplies a and x, which are only multiplied (rule R3
# asks no guard of them); y is a stored array, written through Kairn.
# Its bound, relative to the terms |a x| + |y|, from those of mul_1_1 and add_1_1, eps = u/(1+u):
#   |z - (a x + y)| <= eps (2 + eps) |a x| + eps |y| + (1 + eps) eta/2,
# and eps (2 + eps) = u (2 + 3u)/(1 + u)^2, (1 + eps)/2 = (1 + 2u)/(2 + 2u) <= 2/3.

p = mul_1_1(a, x)
z = add_1_1(p, y)
```

## Measured

The stored brute-force runs of this kernel's code: the oracle judged, in exact arithmetic, the results of the compiled kernel (every compiler, scalar and packed code, every contraction setting) on random operands of `binary64` and `binary32`, and those of the generator's interpreter on every operand of small formats. A measurement, not a bound. A run is shown only if it ran the code the kernel has now: its generated C++ (scalar and packed, every kernel it calls inlined, with the functions it calls; comments left out) must be the same at the commit of the run, as the fingerprints in [`results/brute-code.json`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/results/brute-code.json) show ([How to read a page](reading.md#what-the-measured-numbers-are)).

**Milestone 2**: the runs of commit `5f597fb`, from the stored summaries in [`results/milestone2/brute/`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/tree/main/results/milestone2/brute) ([the report](../developer/results/brute-milestone2.md#axpy_step_1)).

| Run | Cases judged | Failed | largest error / bound | Bound attained |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `binary64` (`double`), compiled: 90 runners on 3 machines | 95 965 758 | 0 | 1 − ε, ε < 10⁻⁹ | no |
| `binary32` (`float`), compiled: 90 runners on 3 machines | 96 114 312 | 0 | 0.9999998510 | no |
| toy formats, every operand: 5 domains of 5 formats | 1 994 977 | 0 | 0.851686 (`fp:3:-8:1`) | no |

## Not claimed

- Anything when an operand is infinite or NaN, or when an operation of the kernel overflows: what is proved and what is not written yet there is in [What holds today](../getting-started/guarantees.md#overflow-and-non-finite-values).
